Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Another personal message... same standards as before.

I cannot express my joy to see as many die-hard fanatics of the game as
I have over the past month or so as I have been here. A lot of you care
about the game, and that is great. I myself am an avid fan of the game,
and this is very reassuring.

My pledge: I will try to work to make sure that your voices are heard.
Your dedication to the game is important to me, and I will try to live
up to my duties.

--Shawn F. Carnes

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 26 Aug 1996, Shawn F. Carnes wrote:

> My pledge: I will try to work to make sure that your voices are heard.
> Your dedication to the game is important to me, and I will try to live
> up to my duties.

Thank you for your reassurances. I don't expect you to agree with
everything we think, but I am glad to hear you will at least try to listen.
